why: The registry card's keep: one document an hour with GitHub's registry as an anonymous pull reads it (each image, whether it is public, its tags and its newest v tag) and the tag each web app runs from the plan card's hour, partitioned on the UTC day. The Azure Container Registry it once described is retired (ADR-009, the addendum on retiring it); the card keeps no minute, because nothing it reports moves inside an hour. Documents expire thirty-one days after they are written.
